ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing (NOT a Phase D regression) — role gate blocks primary_owner: `canPrescribe = user.role === 'owner' || user.role === 'doctor'` (line 38) never matches the current `primary_owner` role, so the list is stuck on the 'Prescriber Access Only' empty-state for Dr. Joshi. Backend /api/prescriptions returns 200 to primary_owner via require_prescriber capability delegation (confirmed iteration 22), so the fix is purely FE: broaden the check to include primary_owner / super_owner / partner (or drive it from /api/me/capabilities.prescribe). Screen still renders without errors, no crash.

action_items: PRE-EXISTING (surface for E1 awareness — NOT introduced by Phase D): app/prescriptions/index.tsx line 38 role check is stale after the primary_owner rename. Recommend switching to `user.role in ['owner','primary_owner','super_owner','partner','doctor']` or, better, `user?.capabilities?.prescribe === true` sourced from /api/me/capabilities so future role additions don't break the gate again. Backend already delegates to require_prescriber capability, so BE will keep working.

routers/patient_registry.py — GET /api/registry/patients/{patient_id} history join: correctly uses indexed patient_id primary + phone-suffix regex fallback for legacy unstamped rows, wrapped in tenant_filter(allow_global=True). services/patient_registry.py::resolve_patient — phone-wins identity ordering is correct (phone $or {phone_digits:p} OR {phone:regex(p+'$')} first, email fallback second). Guards create=False path.
